options.containertransparency.title: Container Transparency
options.container-transparency.container: Adjusts the background opacity of container and inventory screens. Also controls the Recipe Book background and Search Bar.
options.container-transparency.slot.tool: Adjusts the intensity of the highlight when hovering over an item slot.
options.container-transparency.container:
Adjusts the color brightness of container titles to improve contrast with dark/light mode resource packs.
Left = Whiter
Middle = Default
Right = Darker
options.container-transparency.recipe_bo: Adjusts the opacity of the recipe book icon inside your inventory.
Adjusts the background opacity of all discovered recipes.
options.container-transparency.container: Adjusts the opacity of potion icons inside your inventory.
Adjusts the opacity of the gray potion background inside your inventory.
Adjusts the opacity of the potion names and durations in your inventory.
options.container-transparency.hud.potio: Adjusts the opacity of active potion icons on the main screen.
Adjusts the opacity of the gray potion backgrounds on the main screen.
